_comment: The Pi Agent Interface mark, "Face" (an amber face with two upright eyes on a near-black tile), from ../pai-assets/logo/face/ (inner SVG markup on the 64 grid). `svg` is mark-small.svg, the drawing for 20 to 47 px, used by components/logo.tsx (28 px, nav bar); `svgRegular` is mark.svg, the drawing for 48 px and up. The tile carries the mark on light pages too; mark-bare.svg (the face alone) is for dark surfaces only and isn't used here. Written by `npm run logo -- face` (scripts/sync-logo.mjs), which also copies the favicons, icons and og-card into public/. If the logo changes, run it again and commit.
